capabilities.body: OpenAmer ebongisaka mosala, esalaka yango na bisaleli ya solo — terminale, navigateur, bafisye, kode — mpe ebatelaka oyo esalaki malamu.
capabilities.title: Mosungi oyo akanisaka elongo na yo

capabilities.body: Masolo, makundoli mpe modele ebatelami na masini oyo. Eloko moko te etindamaka soki osengi te.
capabilities.title: Masini na yo, badone na yo

capabilities.body: Minɔkɔ 186, mokomoko na lolenge ya bokomi oyo otángaka. Lokasa ya liboso ya aplike esɛngaka opona monɔkɔ.
capabilities.title: Monɔkɔ na yo, ndenge esengeli

capabilities.body: Mayele ebatelamaka na misala oyo esalemi, yango wana misala ya mokolo na mokolo ezwaka ntango moke soki ozali kosalela yango mingi.
capabilities.title: Makoki oyo ekolaka

help: Talá soki masini oyo ekoki kokɔta na internet.
Bandá kobongisa lisusu — matambe oyo esili ekozongelama te.
Soki elongi te mbala mibale, fungolá mikanda ya makambo; milɔngɔ ya nsuka elakisi litambe.
failure.lead: Mbongwana moko te elongolami na nkuku — OpenAmer etikalaka esika etɛlɛmaki, mpo soki obandi lisusu ekoba wana.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ezali kaka na ebimeli ya liboso mpe ezali kosala. Eloko moko te ebongwani ndambo.
failure.title: Kobongisa esili te

language.lead: Kobongisa ekokoba na monɔkɔ oyo oponi awa. Okoki kobongola yango na nsima na aplike.
language.title: Poná monɔkɔ na yo

progress.lead: Kobongisa mbala moko: OpenAmer ezali kozwa oyo esengeli mpe kobongisa masini oyo. Soki ofungoli yango na nsima, ekosɛnga lisusu nyonso wana te.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ezali kotya ebimeli ya sika na esika ya oyo ya liboso. Misala na yo, makundoli mpe mabongisi ekotikala ndenge ezali.
progress.title: Kobongisa OpenAmer

stages.configure: Kobongisa bafungola ya API mpe modele
stages.dependencies: Kotia biloko oyo Python esengeli na yango
stages.handoff: Komibongisa mpo na kozongisa na sika
stages.node-deps: Kotia biloko oyo Node.js esengeli na yango
stages.platform-sdks: Kotia SDK ya baestrade ya bansango
stages.repository: Kosala kopi ya ebombelo ya OpenAmer
stages.venv: Kosala esika ya mosala ya Python ya komekola

cards.body: Fungolá aplike mpe limbolá oyo olingi esalema. OpenAmer esalaka na nsima mpe epesaka yo nsango ya matomba.
cards.title: Bandá na fraze moko

cards.body: Mabongisi → Bomonisi → Monɔkɔ. Minɔkɔ ya bisika 186, okoki kobongola yango ntango nyonso.
cards.title: Poná monɔkɔ na yo

cards.body: Mosala oyo ezongelamaka ekómaka mayele — mbala ya nsima, etinda moko ekoki.
cards.title: Tiká yango ekanisa

success.command: to bandisá yango na nsima na terminale:
success.errorTitle: Ekoki kobandisa aplike ya biro te
success.lead: Nyonso ebongi. OpenAmer ezali sikoyo ya yo — na masini oyo, na monɔkɔ na yo.
success.title: OpenAmer ebongi

bullets: Esalaka na masini na yo — masolo na yo etikalaka awa
Minɔkɔ 186, na lolenge ya bokomi oyo otángaka
Okoki kobongola nyonso na nsima; eloko moko te ekotikala libela
welcome.lead: Mosungi na yo moko. Na masini na yo. Na monɔkɔ na yo.
welcome.leadUpdate: Ebimeli ya sika ya OpenAmer ebongi. Ekozwa esika ya oyo ya liboso mpe ekobatela misala mpe mabongisi nyonso.
welcome.note: Ezwaka mwa miniti soki internet ezali malamu.
welcome.title: Boyei malamu na OpenAmer
